Attached is a short error snippet and the curl we used to repro (curl_repro.sh). TL;DR: small payloads (~50 items) with batching. No client-side rate limit hit.

Subject: Re: Embed/reranker 500s during high-volume test

Thanks for the payload and logs — I started digging into the server traces. Preliminary notes:
- We see repeated 502/503s originating from the reranker worker process; stack traces point at the candidate scoring path where we call the cross-attention kernels for long sequences.
- Some 5xxs correlate with requests that had unusually long candidate contexts (>1500 tokens after concatenation). Those cause memory pressure and OOM/retry behavior in our runtime.
- In a couple of traces the client was sending chunked Transfer-Encoding and we saw keepalive dropouts (rare).

Immediate mitigations to try on your side:
1) Limit per-request candidate concatenation to <= 1000 tokens or send smaller candidate batches (we recommend <= 25 candidates for now).
2) Increase client-side timeout to 90s (some of our rerank work can exceed default 30s under pressure).
3) If possible, enable lightweight embedding-only warmup traffic a few minutes before ramp to populate KV cache.

Dev note: I'll reproduce locally with your payload and open an infra ticket for kernel-level tracing.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Applied ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: dev_patel@redwood.ai <dev_patel@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-06-27T08:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Embed/reranker 500s during high-volume test

Hi all — I reproduced the 5xx locally using the attached repro script. Two quick fixes we pushed to a short-lived canary:
- Validate Content-Type header strictly (we saw some clients omit application/json which triggered a different code path).
- Add backpressure when candidate_length_tokens > 1000 (returns 429 instead of forwarding to the heavy scorer).

I'm including a small patch and a curl example that sets --max-time 90. See redwood-debug-trace-0626.json for server-side trace snippets.

Next steps we propose:
- Finlytics to run the updated curl_repro.sh (I attached an updated version) with --max-time 90 and candidate batch size 20.
- If you still see 5xxs, capture one raw request id from the response and paste it here so we can match the trace.

-Dev
